	projector = function(src, x, y, type, dam, state)
		state = initState(state)
		useImplicitCrit(src, state)
		DamageType:get(DamageType.ACID).projector(src, x, y, DamageType.ACID, dam)
		local target = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
		if target and src and src:knowTalent(src.T_SAFETY_OVERRIDE) then
			local inc = src:callTalent(src.T_SAFETY_OVERRIDE, "getBoltDamageIncrease")/100
			local dur = src:callTalent(src.T_SAFETY_OVERRIDE, "getBoltDuration")
			
			local effs = target:effectsFilter({status="detrimental", types={physical=true, magical=true, mental=true,}}, 50)
			local nb = #effs
			if nb > 0 then
				for _, eff_id in ipairs(effs) do
					target.tmp[eff_id].dur = target.tmp[eff_id].dur + dur
				end
				for i = 1, nb do
					target.turn_procs.debilitating_acid = 1 + (target.turn_procs.debilitating_acid or 0)
					if target.turn_procs.debilitating_acid <= 6 then
						DamageType:get(DamageType.ACID).projector(src, x, y, DamageType.ACID, dam*inc) 
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end,
}
initState=function()return {}end;useImplicitCrit=function()end;Map={ACTOR=1}
local damage={};DamageType={ACID=1,get=function()return {projector=function(_,_,_,_,dam)table.insert(damage,dam)end}end}
local target={tmp={},turn_procs={},effectsFilter=function(self)return self.effects end}
game={level={map=function()return target end}}
local src={T_SAFETY_OVERRIDE=1,knowTalent=function()return true end,callTalent=function(_,_,kind)return kind=='getBoltDuration' and 2 or 10 end}
for initial=0,7 do for nb=0,9 do
 target.tmp={};target.effects={};target.turn_procs={debilitating_acid=initial};damage={}
 for i=1,nb do target.effects[i]=i;target.tmp[i]={dur=3}end
 acid.projector(src,0,0,0,100,{})
 local expected=math.min(nb,math.max(0,6-initial));assert(#damage==1+expected and damage[1]==100)
 for i=2,#damage do assert(damage[i]==10)end
 for i=1,nb do assert(target.tmp[i].dur==5)end
end end
local function steam_tick(self,eff,src)
			if eff.steamstar then
				if DamageType:get(DamageType.FIRE).projector(src, self.x, self.y, DamageType.FIRE, eff.steamstar.dam) > 0 then
					local nb_done = eff.src.turn_procs.steamstar_steam or 0
					eff.src:incSteam(eff.steamstar.steam * 0.3 ^ nb_done)
					eff.src.turn_procs.steamstar_steam = nb_done + 1
				end
			end
end
local yielded={};local actual=1;DamageType.FIRE=2;DamageType.get=function()return {projector=function()return actual end}end
local caster={turn_procs={},incSteam=function(self,n)table.insert(yielded,n)end};local effect={src=caster,steamstar={steam=10,dam=5}}
local self={x=0,y=0}
actual=0;steam_tick(self,effect,caster);assert(#yielded==0 and caster.turn_procs.steamstar_steam==nil)
actual=1;for i=1,4 do steam_tick(self,effect,caster)end
for i,v in ipairs({10,3,0.9,0.27})do assert(math.abs(yielded[i]-v)<1e-9)end
caster.turn_procs={};steam_tick(self,effect,caster);assert(yielded[5]==10)
local function severed(self,eff)
		local severed = false
		local src = eff.src or self
		if core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, src.x, src.y) >= eff.free or src.dead or not game.level:hasEntity(src) then severed = true end
return severed end
core={fov={distance=function(x,y,a,b)return math.abs(x-a)end}};game.level.hasEntity=function()return true end
for _,x in ipairs({5,6,7})do assert(severed({x=x,y=0},{src={x=0,y=0},free=6})==(x>=6))end
